## Summary
PrintWeek coverage of two Infigo partnerships announced together: Trustpilot (review widget) and Enfocus PitStop (PDF preflight). Page returned a thin JS shell on direct fetch; content reconstructed from search summary. Useful primarily for documenting the Trustpilot integration, which is rarely mentioned elsewhere.

## Key takeaways
- **Trustpilot integration:** "Simple integration within the cloud-based Infigo Catfish platform" — drops Trustpilot ratings into Infigo storefronts to drive online conversion. Includes expert advice on building review programs.
- **Enfocus PitStop:** Automatic PDF QC + auto-correct of common print-ready errors. Pre-cursor to the later Connect: Switch and Infigo Connect app integrations.
- **Why this matters now:** If our shop ever wants social-proof on the storefront (reviews on product pages, checkout trust badges), the Trustpilot path is already a vendor-sanctioned integration — no custom build required.
